# v1.3.0-517: no blank box after opening from the tray

Builds on `v1.3.0-515`. One fix for a bug the move to Electron 45 brought in.

## Fixes

- Opening the app from the tray no longer shows a blank, dialog-sized box
  over the window that you can't click or close. It showed after closing to
  the tray and opening again, and after a sign-in start in the tray.
  Minimize and restore were never affected.

## Good to know

- WLM keeps a dialog loaded in the background so the first dialog opens
  fast. It now lets go of that dialog while the app sits in the tray and
  loads a fresh one a moment after the window is back. Dialogs still open
  quickly after a reopen.
